title: Fuel-burning appliances.
officialText:
Liquid combustion by-products of condensing appliances shall be collected and discharged to a
plumbing fixture or disposal area in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions. Condensate piping shall be of
corrosion-resistant material and shall not be smaller than the drain connection on the appliance. Such piping shall maintain a
minimum horizontal slope in the direction of discharge of not less than 1/ unit vertical in 12 units horizontal (1-percent slope).
8
